captions.caption: From under the wing of an aircraft, two military helicopters are seen flying low over a snowy field.
The lead helicopter flies across the snowy landscape, kicking up a cloud of snow from its rotor wash.
The helicopter continues to fly low, with blowing snow trailing behind it.
The helicopter moves further into the distance, still creating a large cloud of snow.
The cloud of snow kicked up by the helicopter becomes more prominent as it flies away.
The helicopter continues its flight path, now partially obscured by the snow it has disturbed.
The lead helicopter is now a distant shape, moving away through the snowy haze.
The helicopter continues to fly into the distance, with the second helicopter still visible in the background.
The cloud of snow begins to settle over the field as the helicopter moves further away.
The snow continues to settle, revealing the snowy landscape more clearly.
The snowy field is now mostly calm, with the second helicopter still hovering in the distance.
A close-up shot shows a different helicopter hovering low over the snow, seen from under an aircraft's landing gear.

The helicopter continues to lower itself for a landing in the snow.

The helicopter maintains its position as it prepares to touch down on the snow.
The helicopter is now just feet above the snow-covered ground.
The helicopter's wheels are about to make contact with the snow during its landing.
The helicopter touches down and begins to settle into the deep snow.
The helicopter is now on the ground, tilting slightly on the uneven terrain.
The helicopter continues to settle after landing in the snow-covered field.
The helicopter is fully landed, and the view is obscured as the camera's perspective changes.
A new shot shows a CH-53 helicopter, marked with "00," sitting stationary in a snowy field.
A side view of the landed military helicopter with its rotors spinning slowly.
The CH-53 helicopter, with "MARINES" written on its side, rests in the snow.
The camera holds on the static shot of the large transport helicopter.
A stationary view of the helicopter in the snow, with trees in the background.
The shot of the landed helicopter remains unchanged.
The view of the helicopter parked in the snow continues.
The static shot of the landed military helicopter persists.
A new shot shows a different CH-53 helicopter with its rear ramp down and a soldier standing guard.

The helicopter, marked "MARINES" and "HMH-366," sits with its rotors spinning.
A side profile view shows the large helicopter at rest on the snowy ground.
The camera holds on the view of the helicopter and the soldier standing guard.
The scene remains static, showing the military presence in the winter landscape.
The view of the landed helicopter with the soldier nearby continues.
The shot of the helicopter remains steady before a scene change.
A new scene shows a column of soldiers in winter camouflage marching through a snowy area.
The soldiers, carrying large backpacks and rifles, walk in a single file line on a snowy path.
The column of soldiers continues its march through the snow, with trees lining the path.
The fully equipped soldiers proceed in a line through the wintery environment.
A close-up shot focuses on one of the marching soldiers wearing a helmet and goggles.
The camera follows the soldier as he marches forward with his heavy gear.
The camera pans to another soldier in the line, also wearing winter camouflage.
The view moves across the faces of several soldiers as they march in the snow.
The camera continues to track the soldiers moving through the wooded, snowy area.
The view follows the column of soldiers as they continue their march.
The shot is slightly out of focus as it pans quickly past the marching soldiers.
The camera focuses on another soldier in the line as the column proceeds.
The camera continues to pan along the line of marching soldiers.
The focus shifts to another soldier's face as he continues the trek.
The camera follows the determined soldiers as they march through the snow.
A new, wide shot shows the entire column of soldiers walking across a vast, open, snowy field.
The soldiers march in a line, with a landed helicopter visible in the background.
A soldier in dark clothing walks in the foreground, while the camouflaged column follows.
The line of soldiers continues its trek across the expansive, snow-covered landscape.
The soldiers make their way across the field, with snow-covered mountains in the far distance.
The soldier in the foreground continues walking as the long column of troops follows behind.
The wide shot emphasizes the scale of the snowy environment as the soldiers march.
